# Environment assets

Photographed materials and outdoor HDR lighting from Poly Haven, distributed
under CC0: https://polyhaven.com/license

- Asphalt 02 — https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02
  1K diffuse, OpenGL normal and roughness JPEG maps.
- Brown Mud Leaves 01 — https://polyhaven.com/a/brown_mud_leaves_01
  1K diffuse and OpenGL normal JPEG maps.
- Kloppenheim 06 Pure Sky — https://polyhaven.com/a/kloppenheim_06_puresky
  1K HDR environment.

Files were downloaded from the official dl.polyhaven.org asset service. The
environment is prefiltered at runtime for car paint, glass and metal reflections.

The world layout and T-04 Meridian and R-09 Summit models are
original code-generated designs. The interface car silhouettes are illustrations.

The Ferrari 458 Italia by vicent091036 is CC BY 4.0; see cars/ATTRIBUTION.md.

Three.js and its loaders are MIT licensed; see ../vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt.

Additional CC0 photographs from Poly Haven:

- Brick Wall 001 — https://polyhaven.com/a/brick_wall_001
- White Plaster Rough 02 — https://polyhaven.com/a/white_plaster_rough_02
- Concrete Wall 001 — https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_001
- Aerial Beach 01 — https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_beach_01
- Rock Boulder Dry — https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_boulder_dry

Wall photographs are composited into varied facade atlases with separate
roughness, relief and window-light masks. Sand and rock are blended into the
terrain by world position. The recorded engine loop is credited separately
in audio/CREDITS.md.
